visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses and short, gray-green hair is positioned in the center, wearing a black button-down shirt. He stands against a neutral indoor background featuring a large, stylized image of a ginger tabby cat yawning widely. He holds a small blue pen-shaped remote and gestures actively with his hands while speaking. The lighting is bright and professionally set, creating a clean studio atmosphere. (2) A scientific scatter plot graph with various colored data points (orange and blue) is superimposed over the man and the background. The graph labels different primate species like 'H. sapiens' and 'G. gorilla'. The man continues to speak and gesture behind the semi-transparent graphic, pointing towards specific data trends. (3) The scene transitions back to a clear shot of the man gesturing towards his own head to emphasize points about evolution. His facial expressions are highly animated, with frequent eyebrow movements and focused eye contact with the camera. The background remains the same with the yawning cat graphic. (4) A detailed 3D digital model of a primate skull appears, color-coded into distinct anatomical regions such as green, blue, pink, and yellow. Labels like 'Anterior neurocranium' and 'Posterior neurocranium' are visible around the model. The man's hands are seen at the bottom of the frame, using his remote to 'point' at sections of the 3D model. (5) A multi-panel grid displaying nine different skull diagrams with associated line graphs is shown. Each panel represents a different species or category within the study. The man is still visible in the lower portion of the frame, providing continuous commentary as the technical diagrams are displayed for comparison.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 訂閱挺健康 掌握健康指南. [Slogan]: 太快了! 人類頭骨二倍速演化. [Subtitle]: 最新研究發現. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們人類的頭骨演化的速度異常快. (3) [Subtitle]: 在所有猿類近親裡，「演化加速器」開到最大. (4) [Subtitle]: 你看，我們跟黑猩猩、大猩猩. (5) [Subtitle]: 這群「人科 (Hominids)」親戚. (6) [Subtitle]: 從臉到腦袋都差很大. (7) [Subtitle]: 特別是各位泛糰 腦洞特大. (8) [Subtitle]: 但我們的遠房親戚長臂猿科 (Hylobatids). (9) [Subtitle]: 他們的家族 9 個物種 幾乎都長得. (10) [Subtitle]: 一模一樣. (11) [Subtitle]: 只是毛色有金有黑有銀灰. (12) [Subtitle]: 毛若剃了比中野家五姐妹還難分. (13) [Subtitle]: 但這很怪. (14) [Subtitle]: 長臂猿科跟人科從共同老祖宗分家的時間. (15) [Subtitle]: 都差不多 2000 萬年前. (16) [Subtitle]: 基因分化程度也接近. (17) [Subtitle]: 為什麼他們如出一轍 我們卻. (18) [Subtitle]: 英國倫敦大學學院的科學家. (19) [Subtitle]: 決定舉辦「天下第一外貌大會」. (20) [Subtitle]: 他們把 7 種人科. (21) [Subtitle]: 對 包括你. (22) [Subtitle]: 和 9 種長臂猿的頭骨. (23) [Subtitle]: 拿去 3D 高密度掃描. (24) [Subtitle]: 成果剛發表在《英國皇家學會會報 B》上. (25) [Subtitle]: 這可不是隨便掃掃. (26) [Subtitle]: 以前的研究只在頭骨上. (27) [Subtitle]: 貼幾個「解剖學標記點」. (28) [Subtitle]: 算是小學等級的連連看. (29) [Subtitle]: 這次科學家用「3D 高密度幾何形態測量學」. (30) [Slogan]: (3d high-density geometric morphometrics). (31) [Subtitle]: 把整個頭骨表面. (32) [Subtitle]: 包含那些以前被忽略的腦殼. (33) [Subtitle]: 全部建成 3D 數位模型. (34) [Subtitle]: 接著把頭骨分成. (35) [Subtitle]: 「前腦殼」、「後腦殼」. (36) [Subtitle]: 「上臉」、「下臉」四個區域. (37) [Subtitle]: 再把長臂猿當作「對照組」或「基準線」. (38) [Subtitle]: 這是因為長臂猿的演化速率超低. (39) [Subtitle]: 幾乎都低於 1. (40) [Subtitle]: 代表他們被「穩定化選擇」(stabilizing selection). (41) [Subtitle]: 按住不動 特別是臉. (42) [Subtitle]: 跟「人科」這一比對 結果有趣了. (43) [Subtitle]: 人類「幾乎」在所有類別都拿下. (44) [Subtitle]: 「演化速率最快」的冠軍. (45) [Subtitle]: 我們累積的形態變化. (46) [Subtitle]: 是「中性演化」預期模型的兩倍. (47) [Subtitle]: 卯起來改頭換面的演化. (48) [Subtitle]: 不輸 Joeman 的自我造化. (49) [Subtitle]: 但科學家發現. (50) [Subtitle]: 我們這群「人科大猿」跟「長臂猿」相比. (51) [Subtitle]: 演化速率飆升的區域. (52) [Subtitle]: 主要集中在「腦殼 (Neurocranium)」. (53) [Subtitle]: 但在「臉部」的演化速率 其實差不多. (54) [Subtitle]: 這代表我們這群親戚各自的腦袋. (55) [Subtitle]: 都在承受巨大的天擇壓力. (56) [Subtitle]: 被迫大改 但臉... (57) [Subtitle]: 臉就... 就只是跟著腦袋長大. (58) [Subtitle]: 順便長長而已. (59) [Subtitle]: 對了 我剛剛說人類「幾乎」全拿冠軍. (60) [Subtitle]: 可是有一個例外. (61) [Subtitle]: 就是「雄性後腦殼」 我們輸了. (62) [Subtitle]: 輸給雄性大猩猩. (63) [Subtitle]: 他們的演化速率 連人類都追不上. (64) [Subtitle]: 但他們不是為了變得跟我們一樣好巧. (65) [Subtitle]: 而是為了長出超爆帥的「矢狀嵴」(cranial crests). (66) [Subtitle]: 來個頭角崢嶸. (67) [Subtitle]: 就跟你朋友熱衷在 IG 上發照片炫耀一樣. (68) [Subtitle]: 這叫「社會性擇」. (69) [Subtitle]: 沒關係 通通封鎖就好. (70) [Subtitle]: 所以人類演化那麼快. (71) [Subtitle]: 可能是為了取得認知優勢. (72) [Subtitle]: 塞下更大的腦. (73) [Subtitle]: 但也可能跟大猩猩一樣. (74) [Subtitle]: 只是為了在小圈圈裡 看起來比較罩. (75) [Subtitle]: 是的 這終究還是個看臉跟腦袋的世界. (76) [Subtitle]: 啥? 不想比臉了 想改當長臂猿. (77) [Subtitle]: 不然 換成比長度也是... 嗯.
